pr_title: LE Audio: Broadcast audio test update
pr_body:
Updates the broadcast audio babblesim tests to use ISO, as well as fixing a few bugs found along the way. 

Fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/44944
pr_comments: Rebased to solve merge conflicts and fix https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/46204#discussion_r914560169

issue_context.title: LE Audio: Add ISO part to broadcast audio bsim tests
issue_context.body:
**Is your enhancement proposal related to a problem? Please describe.**
Broadcast ISO should be working in the babblesim now, and as such the broadcast audio bsim tests can be expanded upon to fully utilize the API. 

**Describe the solution you'd like**
The babblesim tests need to fully use the API including creating and syncing to the BIG.
